summary.data_preservation_status_detail: implementation_metadata[]/reference_identities[] now exist (docs/research/erratum-v2-representation-gaps.md); metadata_not_preserved_ids, reference_identity_not_preserved_ids, top_level_not_preserved_ids and transition_not_preserved_ids below are empty, meaning every candidate v2 round-trips its v1 metadata/identity/top-level-fields/transition-text exactly. This figure is trustworthy only because construction and checker no longer share the coverage-shaped implementation_for_version() lookup: they did, so the baseline metadata of all 21 zero-relevant records was dropped by BOTH and self-confirmed as preserved. Metadata occurrences are now enumerated separately (_v1_metadata_occurrences) and the expected VALUES are re-derived from the raw v1 objects; see zero_relevant_* below for that population reported explicitly. All 247 semantically-equivalent records are REPRESENTATION-READY (representation_ready=247, representation_blocked=0); the 11 parity_only_identity records are a CLASSIFICATION, not a blocker, now that reference_identities[] exists. No data/errata/*.json record has been migrated - this is a readiness finding about the REPRESENTATION, not a migration status.

representative_occurrences.value: Period ruling package on top of the text change. Activation condition: the modern `s.cfilter` (the release-cost filter) also requires `Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.spfilter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,0,1,nil,lv+1,e,tp)`, while the goat cfilter drops it, so the Tribute can be paid with no Insect of the right Level in the Deck. Failed-search verification: the goat operation adds `else Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK)`. Only the verification half is dated by the shared search-verification chronology, so this change is left unresolved.

Period ruling package on top of the text change. Activation condition: the modern `s.spcon`/`s.activate` both require `Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.spfilter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,...)` before offering the Summon, while the goat `s.checkop2` prompts and consumes the effect regardless of whether a monster with 1500 or less ATK is in the Deck. Failed-search verification: the goat operation calls `Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK)` when the selection comes back empty. Only the verification half is dated by the shared search-verification chronology, so this change is left unresolved.

Functional loosening of the summoning restriction: the GOAT script passes the literal true as Fusion.AddContactProc's spsummon-condition argument, which registers a bare EFFECT_SPSUMMON_CONDITION with no value, so the card can be Special Summoned only by the contact-fusion procedure - v1's "This card cannot be Special Summoned except by removing from play the above cards" (full nomi). The modern script instead passes s.splimit, returning not IsLocation(LOCATION_EXTRA|LOCATION_GRAVE), which permits any Special Summon from outside the Extra Deck and the GY; that is the two-clause restriction the lineage first shows at v2 ("can only be Special Summoned from your Fusion Deck by ..." plus "This card cannot be Special Summoned from the Graveyard"), later rendered in PSCT at v4 as "Must first be Special Summoned". Chronology is unresolved because lineage v2 and v3 carry no printing (number and dating_set are null).
